nodes.name: Reply Webhook (Smartlead / Instantly)
nodes.notes: Point Smartlead EMAIL_REPLY and Instantly reply_received webhooks here. Authenticate with ?token= or an X-Webhook-Token header.

nodes.name: Rule Pre-Classifier
nodes.notes: Unsubscribe and out-of-office replies are decided deterministically and never depend on the LLM.

nodes.name: LLM: Classify Reply
nodes.notes: [sandbox-safe] Classification only (no CRM writes). Reply text is redacted (emails, phones, URLs) before sending. Runs in sandbox only when LLM_IN_SANDBOX=true. Failures fall back to rules.

nodes.name: Live Mode?
nodes.notes: [sandbox-gate:live-output=0] Fail-safe: only the exact value "live" reaches HubSpot, owner alerts and SMS.

nodes.name: Assert Live Mode
nodes.notes: Defense in depth: re-reads SANDBOX_MODE before any CRM write.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'email', operator: 'EQ', value: $json.reply.leadEmail }] }], properties: ['email', 'firstname', 'lastname', 'company', 'hubspot_owner_id', 'hs_lead_status'], limit: 1 }) }}

nodes.name: HubSpot: Update Contact
nodes.notes: Sets hs_lead_status and the last_reply_* properties (create them first; see README).

nodes.name: Slack: Find Owner by Email
nodes.notes: Requires the users:read.email scope. Missing owners fall back to SLACK_HOT_LEADS_CHANNEL.

nodes.name: Twilio: Send SMS to Owner
nodes.notes: Optional (SMS_ENABLED=true). Message contains first name + company only, never the reply text.
